SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*),
       SUM(r.amount_minor) * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM refunds AS r
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS v
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

WITH r AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month, p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), w AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk
    FROM r
)
SELECT month, category, revenue * 1.0 / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM w
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE(i.total, 0)) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
                     FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id), 0)
           - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
                       FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.id), 0)
           ELSE 0 END) /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

       CAST(JULIANDAY(DATE(MIN(o.placed_at))) - JULIANDAY(DATE(c.signup_date)) AS INTEGER)

ORDER BY 2, c.name;

FROM products p

LIMIT 4;

SELECT p.name,
       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value AS list_price,
       MIN(i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / m.value AS lowest_price_paid
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN shop_meta m
LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
  AND m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY p.id;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
       SUM(amount_minor) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS total_dollars
FROM refunds
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(v) / 100.0, 2)
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS v
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'

SELECT p.category,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

WITH r AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month, p.category,
         SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), w AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk
  FROM r
)
SELECT month, category,
       revenue / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM w
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items i
           WHERE i.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
                     FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id), 0)
           - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
                       FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.id), 0)
           ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS net_dollars
FROM orders o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.name,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor), 2)
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING 100 * SUM(oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor) > 45 * COUNT(*);

SELECT c.name, julianday(date(MIN(o.placed_at))) - julianday(date(c.signup_date))
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY 2;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
       SUM(amount_minor) * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS total_dollars
FROM refunds
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

WITH r AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month, p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), s AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk
    FROM r
)
SELECT month, category, revenue * 1.0 / (
    SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM s
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name, SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE(i.m, 0)) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS m
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE(i.m, 0)) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH i AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
), r AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.total, 0) - COALESCE(r.total, 0)
                ELSE 0 END)
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS net_dollars
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY month;

       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(i.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor), 2) AS percentage
FROM products p
JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING 100 * SUM(i.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor) > 45 * COUNT(*);

SELECT c.name,
       julianday(date(MIN(o.placed_at))) - julianday(date(c.signup_date))
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY 2;
